publication issues.summary: The final candidate SHA256 bf038eced7578fefaf1016e484a2ecc20f5430dd799335fe8819b655e2bd1a4a extends sealed DS021 candidate 627, SHA256 9b43c435633e89a71b2cd90e06bd4469dc0af135da265c9441b3c3b6058cecc7. All files bound by the previous 627 manifest were rehashed and match; 624 remains unchanged. This is private and uninstalled, pending Root review; it is not a source, electrical, schema or publication approval. The independent outside626 review identified two inherited issues. Note-source span and overlap validation now occurs before rendering, so a renderer exception cannot bypass those checks; render exceptions on a valid note retain existing render_unsupported behavior. The auxiliary guard now checks all four physical-side observation fields in both literal and mirrored lists and rejects any value other than right/output/R. The guard does not infer a terminal role or join. Eight focused tests passed. They include an actual FA121 model modified only in memory to introduce a mirrored left-side observation, a private modified-model CLI run that blocks with auxiliary_placement and emits no page, and successful conversion of the unchanged model. Independent read-only review additionally checked left/input/null values for all four mirrored fields. For CA091, tests inject a wrong source span or overlap and a forced renderer exception into the converter; both checks reject. An in-process main() test with injected post-conversion bad span and renderer failure returns blocked note_source_span and emits no page. These failures are simulated; no naturally failing production input has been demonstrated. Valid CA091 under simulated render failure retains render_unsupported behavior. The four existing DS021 span tests also pass. An earlier test trial errored because it expected rejection at convert() when the guard correctly rejected during Converter construction; the failed trial is preserved and the corrected test covers both constructor and main path. Final-hash runs against unchanged actual inputs: FA121 exit 0, CA091 exit 0 with findings, DS021 exit 0 with findings, AP801 exit 2 output_owner (existing duplicate AN4/AR route HOLD). The FA121, CA091 and DS021 rendered TXT bytes match the prior private outputs exactly. The three emitted outputs have partial review, approve Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission remain bounded by source review.
